title: 第13章 男人都是大猪蹄子第14章 甜美心善柳依依
slug: 都市修仙五年下山就无敌
content_zh:
被亲了！
柳盈盈美眸渐渐睁大。
回过神的她试图推开叶凡，明明很用力了，可叶凡身体纹丝不动。
这一吻很久。
久到柳盈盈放弃了挣扎，她缓缓闭上眼，长长的睫毛轻颤。
叶凡这依旧生涩的吻，让柳盈盈想起了初吻。
还是跟五年前一样，叶凡的吻技没有丝毫长进，一点也不温柔。
不对，还是有长进的……
柳盈盈察觉到叶凡撑在墙上的手，不知不觉搂到了她的腰间，然后慢慢向上移。
她用力一咬，叶凡吃痛捂着嘴：“怎么咬我舌头……”
“叶凡，下不为例，再敢对我耍流氓，我就把你阉掉！”
“对，阉掉，男人都是大猪蹄子，不过就怕老姐你不舍得。”
不远处传来附和声，叶凡扭头看去，一个与柳盈盈长相近乎完全相同的女人坐在楼梯台阶上，正笑眯眯撑着下巴。
像。
实在是太像了。
不论是发型脸型身材还是声音，叶凡都险些认为那是第二个柳盈盈。
“柳依依，你什么时候回来的！”
“在你被壁咚到脸红心跳的时候回来的。”
不同于姐姐柳盈盈的端庄清冷，妹妹柳依依性格明显更加古灵精怪，赤着脚丫凑到叶凡身前，上上下下认真打量了一番。
“你就是叶凡呀，长得还蛮帅的，难怪我姐念念不忘了五年，半夜还偷偷哭。

“闭嘴，我从没哭过！”
“姐，声音太大会被小叶子听到哦。”
“……柳依依，给我回房间去，否则就从我家搬走。”柳盈盈压低声音威胁道。
“搬走就搬走喽。”
柳依依笑眯眯道：“但是我亲爱的姐姐，你应该也不想假扮夫妻这件事被小叶子知道吧？”
“你——”
柳盈盈气得酥胸乱颤，很让人担心衣衫扣子会不堪重负突然崩开。
“在国外这几天都没吃饱，很怀念麻辣小龙虾，要是有人给做就好了。”
“……行。”
“麻辣的想吃，蒜蓉的也很想吃，这该怎么办呢。”
自言自语的柳依依，目光瞟向亲姐姐，意味不言而喻。
“好，我做！”
柳盈盈近乎是咬着牙答应的。
“哎呀，那就幸苦老姐了。对了，我刚才什么也没看到，二位继续。”
柳依依双手扩在嘴边，大声喊道：“小叶子快出来，猜猜谁回来啦。”
“麻麻……不对，是小姨，小姨抱抱！”
content_en:
Got kissed!
Liu Yingying's beautiful eyes gradually widened.
After she regained consciousness, she tried to push Ye Fan away. She was obviously very hard, but Ye Fan's body did not move at all.
The kiss was long.
After a long time, Liu Yingying gave up her struggle. She slowly closed her eyes, her long eyelashes trembling slightly.
Ye Fan's still jerky kiss reminded Liu Yingying of her first kiss.
It was still the same as five years ago. Ye Fan's kissing skills had not improved at all, and he was not gentle at all.
No, there is still progress...
Liu Yingying noticed Ye Fan's hand on the wall, unknowingly put his arm around her waist, and then slowly moved up.
She bit hard, and Ye Fan covered his mouth in pain: "Why are you biting my tongue..."
"Ye Fan, if you don't follow this example, if you dare to act like a gangster to me again, I will castrate you!"
"Yes, castrate. Men are all big pigs, but I'm afraid you won't let me go."
Echoes came from not far away, and Ye Fan turned around to see a woman who looked almost identical to Liu Yingying sitting on the steps of the stairs, smiling and holding her chin.
picture.
It's so similar.
Regardless of her hair style, face shape, body shape or voice, Ye Fan almost thought that she was the second Liu Yingying.
"Liu Yiyi, when did you come back!"
"I came back when you were so hard on the wall that your face was red and your heart was beating."
Unlike her elder sister Liu Yingying, who was dignified and cold, her younger sister Liu Yiyi was obviously more eccentric. She walked barefoot in front of Ye Fan and looked at him carefully up and down.
"You are Ye Fan, you are quite handsome. No wonder my sister has not forgotten you for five years and secretly cried in the middle of the night.
"Shut up, I never cried! "
"Sister, if the sound is too loud, Little Ye Zi will hear it. "
"...Liu Yiyi, go back to your room, or you will move out of my house. Liu Yingying lowered her voice and threatened.
"Just move away. "
Liu Yiyi smiled and said: "But my dear sister, you don't want Xiao Yezi to know about pretending to be a couple, right? "
"You——"
Liu Yingying was so angry that her chest was trembling, and it was very worrying that the buttons of her clothes would be overwhelmed and suddenly burst open.
"I haven't had enough to eat these days abroad. I miss spicy crayfish very much. It would be great if someone could cook it for me. "
"……OK. "
"I want to eat spicy food, and I also want to eat garlic food. What should I do? "
Liu Yiyi, who was talking to herself, glanced at her sister, the meaning was self-evident.
"Okay, I'll do it! "
Liu Yingying almost gritted her teeth and agreed.
"Oh, that's lucky, sister. By the way, I didn't see anything just now, you two continue. "
Liu Yiyi put her hands in front of her mouth and shouted loudly: "Little Ye Zi, come out quickly, guess who is back. "
"Mom... no, it's my aunt, give me a hug! "
